verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth offers cloud backup/sync via iCloud or Google Drive to protect tokens across devices, and a browser extension that relays codes to a computer by pairing with the phone (not independent storage) (docs-2, docs-23, docs-3, docs-25). However, community evidence shows real 'multi-device sync' is a paid-tier feature (comm-2), and the extension requires the phone to be present rather than truly independent computer storage, so simultaneous, fully automatic sync across phone/tablet/computer is only partially delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of true real-time simultaneous sync across all three device types without phone dependency, and confirmation that free-tier iCloud/Drive sync behaves as live sync rather than manual backup/restore.
